zh: 新建一栋房子只可能把它左边紧挨的一段和右边紧挨的一段连起来，其他连续段都不受影响，而最长长度只会增加不会减少。
用哈希表记录已占用的位置，并在每一段的两个端点上存这段的长度；新位置的左邻居一定是左段的右端点，右邻居一定是右段的左端点，它们存的长度可以直接用。
处理位置 x：若已占用，答案不变；否则取 left 为 x−1 处的长度（没有则 0）、right 为 x+1 处的长度，total 为 left+right+1，把 x、x−left、x+right 三处都记为 total，并用 total 更新最大值。每一步后输出当前最大值，用空格分隔。
en: A new house can only join the run touching it on the left with the run touching it on the right; every other run is unaffected, and the longest length never decreases.

Keep a hash map of occupied positions and store each run's length at both of its endpoints. A new position's left neighbor must be the right end of the left run and its right neighbor the left end of the right run, so their stored lengths can be used directly.

For position x: if it is already occupied, the answer stays the same. Otherwise let left be the length stored at x−1 (0 if none), right the length at x+1, and total = left+right+1; store total at x, x−left and x+right, and update the maximum with total. After each step print the current maximum, separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A hash map stores the occupied positions and the length recorded at both ends of each run. A new position merges the adjacent runs on its left and right, then updates both ends of the new run and the global maximum.

## Why it works

When the new position is not yet occupied, any occupied neighbor must be an endpoint of its run, so its recorded length can be used directly. The merged length is left length + 1 + right length; only the endpoints of the new run need updating for later lookups. A repeated insertion leaves the set unchanged.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), extra space O(n).
